list: All 55 official trophies as PlayStation publishes them (checked against Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
missableRule: MISSABLE means the official description pins the trophy to a single named story mission, to one character's last mission, to a window where your partner must be with you, or to one story beat that happens once. Chapter trophies and the finale trophy are not flagged — finishing the story earns them. Free-roam counts and collectibles are not flagged either — the descriptions leave them open after the story.
sourcing: Only the names, descriptions, grades and counts come from the official list. Each guide in this file was written for this entry from that description alone. GTA VI released on 19 November 2026, so there is no finished playthrough to copy steps from yet — and none is copied here. When a description gives no place or step, the guide admits it instead of guessing one.

trophies.guide: The platinum is automatic: it unlocks the instant the other 54 trophies are done, so it needs no plan of its own. Follow the five roadmap stages in order and treat the 100% completion gold as the final real hurdle — once that pops, this one follows.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and the trophy unlocks with the mission-complete screen. It is the first mission of the game, so any normal playthrough reaches it. It is flagged only because the description ties it to that one mission — if you move past the opening somehow without finishing it, replay the mission from the mission menu instead of starting a new game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1; the trophy arrives when the chapter ends. The description asks for chapter completion and nothing else, so there is no side objective to prepare. It cannot be missed — the story cannot continue until the chapter is done.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Clear all of Chapter 2's missions and the trophy pops as the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies, it only asks that the chapter be finished. Unmissable on any playthrough that keeps following the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and this unlocks at the chapter's end. The description names no extra task, so just keep playing the missions in order. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete the last chapter before the finale and the trophy pops when Chapter 4 closes. It is a completion trophy only, with no optional objective named. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Beat the final mission and this gold is yours. It is the endpoint of the story, so anyone who finishes the campaign earns it. The description mentions no choice inside the mission, so do the free-roam cleanup before or after the finale as you like.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run through to its end. It is flagged because the description attaches it to that single mission: finish the mission and it unlocks, and if you pass it by, replay it rather than pushing on. No extra objective inside the mission is named in the description.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Flagged because it belongs to that one mission alone — play it to the end and the trophy unlocks with it. The description gives no additional objective, so there is nothing extra to set up beforehand.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is flagged because the description ties it to that one mission. Finish the mission and the trophy pops; the description names no optional step inside it, so nothing extra is needed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Flagged because it is tied to that single mission: see it through to the end and the trophy unlocks. The description names no extra objective.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Flagged because the description ties it to that one mission. Finish it and the trophy pops; no extra objective is named.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Flagged because it belongs to that one mission only. Play it to the end and the trophy unlocks with the mission; the description names no extra objective inside it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own tally of story, stranger strands, activities and collectibles. It is not missable, only long: the in-game stats screen shows what is still missing. Clear the flagged story trophies first, then grind the counted sets in this guide, and this gold pops when the counter reaches 100%.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Rack up 250 stunts in total — jumps, near misses, airtime and the rest — anywhere on the map. The count is cumulative and the description sets no place or vehicle, so every stunt counts wherever it happens. It stays open in free roam after the story, so let it build up while you travel and then mop up the remainder with repeated jumps.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the 9 activity types once — racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest of the set. One attempt at each is enough; the description asks for a try, not a win. Every activity stays open in free roam, so tick them off early and learn where each one lives.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold in every one — a pass is not enough — which makes this the toughest skill trophy on the list. The description names no range, so use any shooting range the game offers and clear the challenges one by one. It is not missable, and it is best saved until your weapons are upgraded and you have a steady routine for each challenge.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location does it, so visit every race spot and win there. The description gives no list of the locations, so follow the race markers in the game. Drone races stay open in free roam, so this is not missable.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different matters: winning the same race twice counts once, so spread your wins across the race list. Any vehicle class a race allows is fine, and no place is set by the description. Races stay open in free roam, so this is not missable.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head, so catching fish on your own does not count. The description names no spot, so take the challenge wherever Cal offers it. Fishing stays available in free roam, so this is not missable.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to finish at any arcade machine. Any game qualifies, and the description asks for a completion, not a high score. Arcades stay open in free roam, so this is not missable — pick the shortest game you find and see it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Andy's strand. It is flagged because the description ties it to that one final mission for this character: once his strand ends, there is no later mission of his to fall back on. Play his missions in order and complete the last one; the description names no extra objective inside it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Kenton's strand. Flagged because it belongs to that one final mission: when his strand closes, the trophy's moment is gone. Work through his missions as they appear and finish the final one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Billy's strand. Flagged because the description ties it to that one last mission for Billy. Complete his strand in order; the description names no extra objective inside the final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as map icons as you explore, and a strand only counts when its last mission is done. It is not flagged: the description sets the count at 8 and the strands stay available in free roam, so finish the character finals in stage 2 first and this silver follows.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Randy's strand. Flagged because it belongs to that one final mission for Randy. Play his missions in order and complete the final one; no extra objective is named in the description.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Tyrone's strand. Flagged because the description ties it to that one last mission for Tyrone. Complete his strand in order; the description names no extra objective inside it.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are the collectible here: find each one and meditate there, and the counter climbs. The description gives no list of spots, so use the in-game map markers and sweep the regions in order. Not missable — the spots stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Flagged because the description ties it to Bret's hunt: a unique animal is a one-off quarry, so take the hunt when Bret offers it and do not let the animal get away. The description names no species or place, so follow Bret's directions inside the mission itself.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, and a set only counts when every card in it is found. The description gives no card locations, so sweep the map and use the collection screen to see which sets are close. Not missable — cards stay findable in free roam.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-style check-in, so the work is visiting places and using it at each one. Repeats do not count — only different locations. The description gives no location list, so work through the map region by region. Not missable — the locations stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total, across every challenge type the game tracks. Challenges are the small goals layered over normal play, so many will finish themselves while you chase other trophies. The description gives no list, so check the challenges screen for what is close and clear the easy ones first. Not missable.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Flagged because the description needs your partner beside you, and partner availability is a story window — do it while the story still puts you together. To raise the heat, cause trouble in a busy area, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, and keep your wanted level through all three — the chain breaks if the wanted level drops. Flagged because it needs your partner, a story window. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them one after another without waiting, and keep moving between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Discovery means getting in or registering a vehicle type you have not found before, so variety is what counts, not repeats. The description gives no vehicle list, so drive everything you see and use the collection screen to spot gaps. Not missable — vehicles stay discoverable in free roam.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode, so trigger it when five enemies are grouped in front of you and take all five down before it ends. Not missable — you can retry it in any fight. A busy shootout or a gang hideout gives you the numbers.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get a plane off the ground without a scheduled flight. The description names no aircraft or runway, so take any plane you can reach on the airfield and take off. Not missable — the airport stays open in free roam, so you can retry it any time.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tanks, and the description is a joke rather than an instruction — so the honest read is: get into a Rhino tank situation and deal with it. Rhinos show up at high wanted levels, so push the heat to the top and survive the tanks that roll in. Not missable — wanted levels stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: get in, take the goods and get out before anyone spots you or the alarm trips. Stealth is the whole ask, so move slowly, watch sightlines and leave before the store can react. Not missable — you can retry a jewelry store in free roam.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big robberies, so each one needs a plan and a getaway: hit the vault, then break away clean. The count is cumulative across the game. Not missable — vaults stay robbable in free roam.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city, so find one on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away before the cops close in. Not missable — trucks keep running in free roam, so you can retry it any time.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida, the whole state. The counter climbs as you set foot in each named area, so the work is a full map sweep: drive, fly and walk into every corner. The description gives no area list, so use the map to find the grey patches. Not missable — the whole state stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations, so you need one hit per gang, not nine hits on the same gang. The description names no gang list or operation spots, so use the in-game markers for gang activity. Not missable — operations stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or vendor on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take it in with the view. The description names the beach, not a specific bar, so any beachside spot that serves cocktails should count. Not missable — the beach stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. The description names no showroom, so pick any vehicle showroom and make your exit through the window. Not missable — showrooms stay standing in free roam.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through: finish a game there. The description names the alley, so go to that one rather than any other. No score is named, so a completed game is what counts. Not missable — the alley stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is a riddle rather than an instruction: a partnership with mass appeal. Flagged because it reads as a single story beat about the partnership, not a repeatable free-roam task. The honest advice is to play the story naturally and watch for a partnership moment that draws a crowd; no place or step is named in the description, so nothing here is invented.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices, for better or worse, until the counter the game tracks reaches 500. Choices are the small decisions the game keeps count of, so this one completes itself across a long playthrough if you keep engaging with choice moments instead of skipping them. Flagged because choices belong to story beats: a choice passed without making it may not come back.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail something once, then succeed on the second try. The description is a riddle, so the honest read is that it pops when you retry a failed attempt and land it. Not flagged: retrying is the point of the trophy. If a mission or activity fails, run it again straight away.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description is a riddle: something strange happens, once. Flagged because it reads as a single scripted weird moment in the story, not a repeatable task. Play the story with your eyes open for an event that makes no sense; no place or trigger is named in the description, so this guide invents none.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by: attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock them down like pins. The description asks for the drive-by itself, not a count, so one good pass through a group does it. Not missable — you can retry it on any street in free roam.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, and contacts clean them for a cut, so the work is: rob, launder, repeat until the total hits $250,000. The description names no contact, so use whichever contacts the game gives you. Not missable — robberies and laundering stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Any shop counts and the total is cumulative, so buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades as you play and the counter climbs. Not missable — shops stay open in free roam. Save this for late, when money is plentiful, and it will nearly complete itself.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from the property market, so save up and buy each one as it becomes available. The description names no locations, so use the in-game property listings. Not missable — properties stay buyable in free roam.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, then register each one in the app until the count hits 10. Any 10 vehicles count, so use the common ones you pass every day. Not missable — vehicles and the app stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: On the Spot
